welcome:
👋 Welcome to Monad Buy Bot — real-time buy alerts for the Monad ecosystem.

Track any token on Monad (chain ID 143):
• 💱 DEX-listed tokens
• 🧪 Incubation tokens on the bonding curve

Alerts are delivered live to this group and are fully customizable per group: emojis, minimum amounts, whale thresholds and language.

Use /help to explore all commands, or tap ⚙️ Settings to configure everything with buttons.
help:
📖 Command reference

🔹 Tracking
/setup — Guided setup: track a token in 3 taps (admin)
/addtoken <address> — Track a token's buys (admin)
/removetoken <address> — Stop tracking a token (admin)
/tokens — List tracked tokens

🔹 Market data
/price [address] — Token price in MON/USD
/mcap [address] — Token market cap
/incubation [address] — Bonding-curve progress
/tokeninfo [address] — Token card: liquidity, holders, incubation
/stats — 24h buy statistics for this group
/leaderboard — Top buyers in this group
/dashboard — Live auto-updating stats dashboard

🔹 Alerts
/pricealert <address> <above|below> <USDT> — Create a price alert
/alerts — Manage your price alerts
/sells — Toggle sell alerts
/scanner — Toggle new incubation-token alerts

🔹 Configuration (admin)
/setemoji <emoji> — Buy alert emoji
/setwhaleemoji <emoji> — Whale alert emoji
/setminbuy <USDT> — Minimum buy to trigger alerts
/setwhale <USDT> — Whale alert threshold
/setlanguage <en|es|zh> — Group language
/settings — Show current settings

/about — About this bot

about:
🤖 Monad Buy Bot

Real-time buy and sell alerts for any token on Monad (chain ID 143): DEX trades and bonding-curve incubation tokens, with per-group emojis, thresholds and language.

Built for trading communities that need fast, reliable on-chain signals.

Explorer: https://monadvision.com
